# Sterling Crest Bank

> Online banking from Sterling Crest Bank: open an account in minutes, hold USD, EUR and GBP wallets, send local and international transfers, create virtual cards, and apply for loans, tax recovery and fund recovery online.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/): overview of accounts, payments, cards, services and security
- [Open an account](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/register)
- [About us](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/about)
- [Partnerships](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/partnerships)
- [Contact](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/contact): support@sterlingcrestbank.com
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.sterlingcrestbank.com/terms)

## Notes

- Customer dashboards (/dashboard) and staff pages (/admin) require sign-in and are not public content.
